turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: It's always great to get that broader perspective, especially when you're in the thick of it at work. Are you planning on doing any salsa dancing this weekend, or maybe spending some time with Tom?

turns.text: That sounds like a perfect, relaxed Saturday evening plan. I hope the temperature cools down nicely for you both tonight!
